videos.title: Raging Bull
videos.description: The story of a middleweight boxer as he rises through ranks to earn his first shot at the middleweight crown. He falls in love with a gorgeous girl from the Bronx. The inability to express his feelings enters into the ring and eventually takes over his life. He eventually is sent into a downward spiral that costs him everything.

videos.title: California Split
videos.description: Carefree single guy Charlie Waters (Elliott Gould) rooms with two lovely prostitutes, Barbara Miller (Ann Prentiss) and Susan Peters (Gwen Welles), and lives to gamble. Along with his glum betting buddy, Bill Denny (George Segal), Charlie sets out on a gambling streak in search of the ever-elusive big payday. While Charlie and Bill have some lucky moments, they also have to contend with serious setbacks that threaten to derail their hedonistic betting binge.

videos.title: The Heavenly Body
videos.description: William (William Powell) is an astronomer hot on the trail of a comet he just discovered. His wife, Vicky (Hedy Lamarr), feels neglected by the busy man, so she looks to astrology to see if she can truly be happy with her husband. But the stars say she will have a new man in her life, which suddenly looks more likely when William leaves the house, angry that his wife believes in astrology, while military officer Lloyd (James Craig) moves into the neighborhood and catches Vicky's eye.

videos.title: Athena
videos.description: When lawyer and aspiring politician Adam Shaw (Edmund Purdom) meets Athena Mulvain (Jane Powell), she claims the stars tell her they will marry. However, Adam is already engaged to socialite Beth. Furthermore, Adam is confused by Athena's unusual family, which includes six other sisters raised in an extremely health-conscious environment that excludes meat, smoking and alcohol. Gradually, Adam is slowly won over by Athena, even at the detriment of his political future.

videos.title: Human Beasts
videos.description: A hit man double crosses his yakuza employers and flees with a cache of diamonds, taking refuge with a family who have plans of their own.

videos.title: Adventures of Rusty
videos.description: Danny Mitchell (Ted Donaldson) misses his deceased mother and is upset that his father (Conrad Nagel) is remarrying. His stepmother, the kindly Ann (Margaret Lindsay), struggles to connect with the boy. One day, Danny stumbles upon a solution to his loneliness when he encounters his neighbor's dog, Rusty, a vicious German shepherd trained by the Nazis. Danny adopts Rusty and attempts to rehabilitate him, while Ann works on forging a closer relationship with her stepson.

videos.title: Tom & Jerry
videos.description: A sneaky alley cat uses a ventriloquist device to trick an angry bulldog into believing he is in many different places.

videos.title: The Flea Circus
videos.description: A dog threatens the fortunes of a flea circus.

videos.title: The Muppets Take Manhattan
videos.description: When Kermit the Frog and friends start a stage act, they decide to take the show from their college town to Broadway. However, once The Muppets wind up in New York City, they have difficulty finding financial support for the production, instead running into cheats like Murray Plotsky. Unable to stage the show, the group splits up, and they all take different jobs around the country. Just as Kermit thinks he has finally found a backer, an accident gives him amnesia.

videos.title: On the Town
videos.description: Fun-loving sailors Gabey (Gene Kelly), Chip (Frank Sinatra) and Ozzie (Jules Munshin) have 24 hours of shore leave in New York City, and they want to make every second count. While Chip hooks up with loudmouth cab driver Brunhilde (Betty Garrett) and Ozzie swoons for prim anthropologist Claire (Ann Miller), Gabey falls in love with an actress he sees in an advertisement, Ivy Smith (Vera-Ellen). Leonard Bernstein, with lyricists Betty Comden and Adolph Green, provides the music.

videos.title: The Naked City
videos.description: After a former model is drowned in her bathtub, Detective James Halloran (Don Taylor) and Lieutenant Dan Muldoon (Barry Fitzgerald) attempt to piece together her murder. A friend of the victim mentions Mr. Henderson, and the police also find the actions of Frank Niles (Howard Duff) peculiar. As Muldoon and Halloran start to fill in the details of the victim's past, they find that she had a lively social life, filled with many suitors, and the mystery becomes even more complex.

videos.title: Ice Station Zebra
videos.description: A US submarine is dispatched to the frozen wastes of the North Pole to recover a Soviet satellite crammed full of strategic snapshots of US bases. The Cold War atmosphere becomes even chillier as the sub, with a Russian expatriate, a British secret agent and an American marine captain on board, is sabotaged en route.

videos.title: Xploration Awesome Planet
videos.description: Philippe Cousteau Jr. is no stranger to exploration. The grandson of legendary underwater explorer Jacques Cousteau, Philippe hosts and serves as executive producer of this half-hour earth science series that examines the planet. He visits diamond and gold mines to see how gems and metals are formed, travels to active volcanoes to observe what happens inside the Earth's burning core, and checks out weather stations in mountainous areas to get an idea of how weather phenomena form in the atmosphere.

videos.title: Xploration Outer Space
videos.description: Americans have been fascinated by the cosmos for decades and rely on NASA to explore celestial bodies seen in the night sky to get a better idea of what is out there. In this series, former NASA employee Emily Calandrelli visits some of the agency's facilities, private companies and universities to speak with people knowledgeable about the topic to help "show off the coolest aspects of the space industry," to use her words. Technology, a potential manned mission to Mars and planetary tourism are some themes.

videos.title: Nature Knows Best
videos.description: Marine biologist Danni Washington hosts this series that explains how nature has helped to inspire technology that people use on a daily basis. Some of the nature-inspired innovations include airplanes inspired by birds and helicopters that were influenced by dragonflies. The show also introduces viewers to people involved in creating innovations that are based on animals, including biologists who study the behavior of ants, architects designing "living buildings" and roboticists who are making their designs bigger and stronger based on animals.

videos.title: Animal Rescue
videos.description: Just about everybody likes animals and doesn't like to see animals who are sick, injured or abused. So "Animal Rescue," a weekly series -- aimed at children and families -- that showcases spectacular rescues of animals, should be very popular. Because people don't like to see an animal's situation get so bad that it requires rescue, the program tries to avoid those situations by instructing children on the proper care of animals, as well as giving safety tips on caring for all types of creatures.

videos.title: Jelly Jamm
videos.description: Bello y Gnomo están decididos a resolver el misterio de quién está robando la fruta del jardín real.

videos.title: Jelly Jamm
videos.description: Rita pierde a Princess y recorre desesperadamente el planeta Jammbo para encontrarla.

videos.title: Jelly Jamm
videos.description: La Reina sale de vacaciones y el Rey se queda a cargo de todas las responsabilidades por lo que busca a una persona que lo ayude.

videos.title: Jelly Jamm
videos.description: Los chicos están contando historias escalofriantes durante un campamento; Goomo cuenta la historia más aterradora acerca de un monstruo y luego va a buscar un bocadillo.

videos.title: Jelly Jamm
videos.description: Tras cometer un error Bello se escuda en una historia muy poco verosímil. Mina, enfadada con él, le someterá a una dura prueba: "El Caramelo De La Verdad". Un caramelo que hace flotar a aquel que miente.

videos.title: Jelly Jamm
videos.description: Mina intenta construir un columpio increíble para agradar al Rey. Ella pronto descubre que la tecnología no puede reemplazar a la amistad y cooperación.

videos.title: Jelly Jamm
videos.description: A Bello se le asigna un trabajo muy importante: ¡está a cargo de administrar Music Factory! Aunque la Reina deja el manual de instrucciones, Bello lo ignora. Tan pronto como ella se va a tomar un merecido descanso, toda la operación se vuelve loca.

videos.title: Jelly Jamm
videos.description: Rita está cansada de perder en todos los juegos, por eso se alía con unos brazaletes que la ayudarán a ganar todos los juegos de los que participe.

videos.title: Jelly Jamm
videos.description: Los chicos, el Rey y la Reina descubren que su basura causa contaminación y deciden reciclar para restablecer la salud y belleza de Jammbo.

videos.title: Jelly Jamm
videos.description: Cuando Mina descubre cómo volverse invisible y volver objetos invisibles, no puede resistir probarlo en sus amigos desprevenidos; después de un día de acontecimientos extraños e inexplicables los niños descubren que Mina es la culpable.

videos.title: Jelly Jamm
videos.description: Goomo está muy entusiasmado con uno de los eventos más impresionantes en Jammbo.

videos.title: Jelly Jamm
videos.description: Durante una feroz tormenta de truenos y relámpagos, Bello y Goomo buscan refugio.

videos.title: Jelly Jamm
videos.description: El Rey esconde su monopatín propulsado por un cohete dentro de una caja mágica; Goomo y Bello deciden reclamar el monopatín retando los deseos del Rey.

videos.title: Jelly Jamm
videos.description: El Rey y los chicos organizan la mejor fiesta de cumpleaños. Desafortunadamente, todos tienen sus propias ideas de cómo lograr su objetivo.

videos.title: Jelly Jamm
videos.description: Bello se molesta con la Reina cuando cree que ella quiere detener todas sus aventuras. Una noche él desea que la Reina se convierta en niña otra vez. Cuando su deseo se cumple él actúa como el hermano mayor de la Reina.

videos.title: Jelly Jamm
videos.description: La emoción de Goomo por su cumpleaños se evapora cuando despierta y descubre que su amado casco ha desaparecido y ninguno de sus amigos aparentemente recuerda su día especial.

videos.title: Señorita Araña
videos.description: La dulce Miss Spider, posiblemente es el único insecto vegano del mundo, que intenta enseñarle a sus muchos hijos, cómo Shimmer, Dragon, Bounce, Squirt, Spinner, Snowdrop y Pansy, sobre la vida y llevarse bien con los demás.

videos.title: Señorita Araña

videos.title: Leo, el explorador
videos.description: Leo ayuda a una mariposa azul a encontrar un hogar. Durante la aventura conoce a otras mariposas que pronto quedarán desamparadas.

videos.title: Leo, el explorador
videos.description: El Guardia Rocky invita a los Guardas Forestales a una aventura con el objetivo de devolver una orca al mar, pero la tarea se vuelve más difícil cuando encuentran a otra orca encallada en la playa.

videos.title: Leo, el explorador
videos.description: Los pequeños exploradores encuentran una anguila eléctrica en el estanque de un jardín y viajan a América del Sur para regresarla a su hogar.

videos.title: Leo, el explorador
videos.description: Los exploradores encuentran un guepardo sudafricano cachorro y tratan de llevarlo sano y salvo a su casa. Sin embargo, cazadores furtivos logran capturar al animal.

videos.title: Leo, el explorador
videos.description: Leo y sus amigos navegan por el océano para encontrarle un hogar a un pez manta gigante.

videos.title: Leo, el explorador
videos.description: Rocky les da a los exploradores una misión especial: deben regresar un pez luna al océano. Ellos aceptan el desafío, pero tienen algunas dificultades cuando las gaviotas molestan al pequeño animal.

videos.title: Leo, el explorador
videos.description: El equipo lleva a una jirafa de Rothschild a la sabana para que encuentre un hogar.

videos.title: Leo, el explorador
videos.description: Los Jóvenes Exploradores viajan al bosque tropical para reunir a un cachorro de tigre de Malasia con su mamá.

videos.title: Salpicaduras y burbujas
videos.description: Un pez góbido y un camarón llegan a la ciudad en busca de un nuevo hogar; Splash cree que la única manera de conseguir que Dorsal el delfín siga siendo su amigo es preparándole juegos.

videos.title: Splash and Bubbles
videos.description: Splash y Bubbles discuten y deciden no jugar juntos durante un tiempo; Splash es muy bueno jugando a las escondidas.

videos.title: Salpicaduras y burbujas
videos.description: Splash y sus amigos visitan la cueva de un viejo pez bruja, profundo en el abismo; Dunk descubre un erizo de mar bebé escondido en su hogar.

videos.title: Salpicaduras y burbujas
videos.description: Bubbles se hace amigo de un nanoplancton que es invisible.

videos.description: ¿Qué se sabe de los animales que habitan el agua?

videos.title: ZooMoo tiene cerebro
videos.description: ¿Qué se conoce de los escondites de los animales?

videos.title: ZooMoo tiene cerebro
videos.description: ¿Qué se conoce de los monos?

videos.title: ZooMoo tiene cerebro
videos.description: ¿Qué se conoce del hogar de los animales?

videos.title: Estrellas Animales
videos.description: Los velocistas de los Juegos Olímpicos corren muy rápido sobre dos piernas. Se descubre todo acerca de los animales que tienen muchas piernas.

videos.title: Estrellas Animales
videos.description: Ellos son grandes, son fuertes, son rudos. ¡Son osos, osos, osos!

videos.title: Estrellas Animales
videos.description: Hay niños que aman divertirse en la nieve y hay animales a los que les gusta lo mismo. Es por eso que se muestran los animales que aman el frío.

videos.title: Estrellas Animales
videos.description: A algunas personas les encanta divertirse en el río, pero estos temerarios no se divertirán en el programa sobre fantásticos animales de agua dulce.
